resolution: Fixed the crash from the req_0986 face-highlight: the highlight Scene3D.Mesh dynamicKey was 'hi.part0.0.2' (dot-separated, no '~'), violating the host's required '<slotId>~<version>' contract, so it threw on render. Changed it to 'studio.<id>.hi~<seq>' — a stable slot per part with a monotonically bumping version (hiSeqRef) so it reuses ONE dyn slot and re-uploads on selection/geometry change instead of minting a fresh slot per selection (which would leak dyn slots). Bundle-clean; hot-reload TSX; nothing committed.
